name: Xero
summary: Registering a Xero web app is self-serve and you can connect test organisations the same day. Two things shape an agent launch: Xero's developer terms prohibit using API data to train AI/ML models, and connection counts are priced by tier - the free Starter tier allows 5 connections, paid tiers raise the cap.
difficulty_reason: Self-serve setup, but connection caps are tied to paid pricing tiers, AI/ML data-use terms constrain agents, and App Partner certification (for marketplace listing) takes months.

effort.production: Same day (up to 5 connections on Starter); same day on a paid tier for more; App Partner certification takes months if you want an App Store listing
effort.waiting_on: Nothing for a paid tier; App Partner certification (Partner Agreement, technical and security review) only if you want to be a listed partner

bottom_line: Create a Web app with the authorization code flow, request granular scopes plus offline_access, and serialise refresh-token rotation per connection. Plan your connection count against Xero's pricing tiers (Starter: 5 connections, free; Core: 50) and budget for API usage fees. Read the Developer Platform terms before designing your agent: Xero prohibits using API data to train or contribute to AI/ML models. Start App Partner certification early only if you want a Xero App Store listing - it takes months.
app_type: Create a 'Web app' integration. This type uses the standard Authorization Code Flow, allows for secure client secret storage, and enables connections to multiple Xero organizations (tenants), which is ideal for an AI agent.

scope_paths.review: None (connection cap set by pricing tier)

stages.name: Register the app
stages.goal: Obtain Client ID and Client Secret, and register your Redirect URI.

steps.title: Navigate to the Xero Developer Portal
steps.detail: Go to the Xero Developer Portal and log in with your Xero account.

steps.title: Create a new app
steps.detail: Click 'New app'. Provide an App Name (visible to users), select 'Web app' as the Integration type, and enter your Company or application URL. Crucially, add your exact HTTPS Redirect URI(s).

steps.title: Configure scopes
steps.detail: Select the minimum necessary scopes for your application. Always include 'offline_access' for refresh tokens and 'openid', 'profile', 'email' for user identity. For accounting data, use granular scopes like 'accounting.transactions' and 'accounting.contacts'.

steps.title: Save and retrieve credentials
steps.detail: Click 'Save App'. Note your Client ID and Client Secret. The Client Secret is displayed only once.

stages.name: Develop and Test
stages.goal: Successfully connect your own Xero organization or a demo company.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Code Flow
steps.detail: Use your Client ID, Client Secret, and Redirect URI to implement the Authorization Code Grant flow. Ensure you request the 'offline_access' scope to obtain refresh tokens. Consider using PKCE if applicable for native components.

steps.title: Test with a Xero demo company
steps.detail: Connect your application to a Xero demo company to test functionality without affecting live data.

stages.name: Scale to Production (Optional, for >5 tenants)
stages.goal: Become a Xero App Partner to remove the 5-tenant connection limit and enable wider production use.

steps.title: Review App Partner requirements
steps.detail: Familiarize yourself with the Xero App Partner program, including the legal, technical, and security requirements.

steps.title: Apply for Xero App Partner certification
steps.detail: Submit your application, which includes details about your app and business. You will need to sign a Partner Agreement.

steps.title: Pass technical certification and security assessment
steps.detail: Xero will review your app against technical requirements, including secure data storage, privacy policy, and an annual security assessment. Apps with 1000+ connections require an advanced assessment.

token_facts.value: Expires if unused for 60 days. Refresh tokens rotate upon use (a new one is issued with each access token refresh), invalidating the old one.
5 concurrent calls, 60 calls per minute, 1,000 calls per day (Starter tier) or 5,000 calls per day (higher tiers). App-wide limit of 10,000 calls per minute across all tenancies.
HTTP 429 response with a 'Retry-After' header when limits are exceeded.

gotchas.title: AI/ML Model Training Prohibition
gotchas.detail: Xero explicitly prohibits using any data obtained through their APIs to train or contribute to the creation of any AI or machine learning model, effective March 2, 2026. This is a critical policy constraint for AI-driven applications.

gotchas.title: Connection caps are priced by tier
gotchas.detail: The free Starter tier allows 5 connected organisations; going beyond requires a paid tier (e.g. Core, 50 connections). Model your expected customer count against the tier table before launch.

gotchas.title: Granular Scopes for New Apps
gotchas.detail: New apps created on or after March 2, 2026, must use granular scopes (e.g., `accounting.transactions.read`) from day one. Broad scopes like `accounting.transactions` are deprecated for new apps. Ensure you select granular permissions.

gotchas.title: Refresh Token Rotation
gotchas.detail: When you use a refresh token to get a new access token, a *new* refresh token is also issued. You must store and use this new refresh token, as the old one immediately becomes invalid. Failing to do so will break your offline connection.

gotchas.title: API Usage Fees
gotchas.detail: Xero introduced API usage fees starting March 2026, charging $2.40 AUD per GB of data egress (data downloaded from Xero). Ingress (data uploads) remains free.

blockers.symptom: Cannot connect to more than 5 Xero organizations (tenants).
blockers.cause: Connection cap of your current pricing tier reached (Starter: 5).
blockers.next_step: Upgrade to a higher tier in the developer portal, or disconnect unused organisations.

blockers.symptom: Receiving HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors from the Xero API.
blockers.cause: You have exceeded Xero's API rate limits (concurrent calls, calls per minute, or calls per day).
blockers.next_step: Implement robust retry logic with exponential backoff, respecting the `Retry-After` header. Review your application's API usage patterns to optimize calls.

blockers.cause: The `redirect_uri` parameter in your authorization request does not exactly match one of the Redirect URIs configured in your Xero app settings.
blockers.next_step: Double-check your configured Redirect URIs in the Xero Developer Portal and ensure your application sends an identical `redirect_uri` in the authorization request. Ensure it uses HTTPS.

blockers.symptom: Existing user connections break after a period of inactivity.
blockers.cause: The refresh token expired after 60 days without use, or a rotated refresh token was not saved.
blockers.next_step: Ask the user to reconnect; refresh active connections on a schedule and always persist the newest refresh token.

research_notes:
FACTS:
*   Xero supports OAuth 2.0 for third-party apps, specifically the Authorization Code Grant type, which can be extended with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for native applications. OpenID Connect is also supported for user identity.
*   For an AI agent acting on behalf of users, the "Web app" integration type is recommended, using the standard Authorization Code Flow. This allows secure storage of the client secret and connection to multiple Xero organizations (tenants). Custom Connections, using the client credentials grant type, are limited to a single organization.
*   Apps are registered in the Xero Developer Portal at `https://developer.xero.com/myapps`. When creating an app, developers provide an app name (shown to users during consent), select "Web app" as the integration type, and specify a Company or application URL and a Redirect URI. The Redirect URI must be exact and use HTTPS.
*   Scopes are additive; developers should request only the minimum necessary permissions for the user's current action. The `offline_access` scope is required to obtain a refresh token and maintain an offline connection. OpenID scopes (`openid`, `profile`, `email`) are used for user identity and single sign-on.
*   Xero has replaced broad OAuth 2.0 scopes (e.g., `accounting.transactions`) with more granular scopes. New apps created on or after March 2, 2026, must use these granular scopes from day one. Existing apps have until September 2027 to migrate to granular scopes, and re-authorization by users is required to apply these new permissions to existing connections.
*   A key restriction for AI agents is Xero's explicit prohibition on using data obtained through their APIs to train or contribute to the creation of any AI or machine learning model, effective March 2, 2026.
*   Uncertified apps are limited to connecting with a maximum of 5 Xero tenants (organizations). To connect to more than 5, an app needs to upgrade to the Core Tier (or above) and become a Xero App Partner.
*   The Xero App Partner certification process involves submitting an application, signing a Partner Agreement, and passing a technical certification. This process can take "several months."
*   Technical requirements for App Partners include:
    *   Having a publicly accessible privacy policy on the app's website.
    *   Ensuring secure storage of Xero data and sensitive details like client secrets, with strict access control.
    *   Not using shared hosting environments.
    *   Using SSL for application logins and ideally all logged-in pages.
    *   Undergoing an annual security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team. Apps with 1000+ connections require an advanced assessment. These assessments cover aspects like API risk rating, authentication, certification, personnel security, encryption, and audit logging.
    *   Providing a setup page for users to connect to Xero and manage integration settings, displaying the connected tenant name and connection status.
    *   If a security assessment fails, partners are given 30 days for a remediation plan and 60 days for implementation.
*   The Xero Partner program for accounting practices is free, but partner tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) are based on points earned from client subscriptions and product use.
*   Xero introduced API usage fees starting March 2026, charging $2.40 AUD per GB of data egress. Ingress (data uploads) is unlimited and free.
*   A Xero demo company can be used for testing without affecting live data. The app name is displayed to users during the consent process.
*   Access tokens are short-lived, expiring after 30 minutes. Refresh tokens expire if unused for 60 days, and they rotate upon use (a new refresh token is issued with each access token refresh). The old refresh token becomes invalid.
*   API rate limits (per-organization, per-app) are: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls per minute, and 1,000 calls per day for Starter tier apps or 5,000 calls per day for higher tiers. There's also an app-wide limit of 10,000 calls per minute across all tenancies. Exceeding limits results in an HTTP 429 response with a `Retry-After` header.
*   Recent changes (roughly May 2025 to November 2026) include:
    *   **Granular Scopes:** New apps from March 2, 2026, must use granular scopes; existing apps have until September 2027 to migrate.
    *   **API Usage Fees:** $2.40 AUD per GB of data egress introduced March 2026.
    *   **AI/ML Prohibition:** Prohibition on using Xero API data for AI/ML model training, effective March 2, 2026.
    *   **User Permissions Update:** Changes to how user roles and permissions are presented, offering more granular control (August 2026).
    *   **TaxNumber Field:** Added to the Contacts endpoint (October 2026).
    *   **US Sales Tax Fields:** Added to Credit Notes and Invoices (2023-2024, within 18 months).
    *   **Contact Matching for Allocations:** Enforcement of matching contacts for allocations via the Accounting API (within 18 months).

CONFLICTS:
*   One third-party source states uncertified apps can connect to 25 organizations simultaneously, while official documentation and other third-party sources state a limit of 5 connections for uncertified apps. The official Xero Developer documentation (OAuth 2.0 page) explicitly states "Apps using the code or PKCE flow can connect to a maximum of 5 tenants." I will prioritize the official documentation.

UNKNOWNS:
*   Stated timelines for general app review (non-partner certification) were not found.
*   Specific requirements for domain, company page, legal entity documentation beyond providing the legal entity name and tax information during the app partner application process were not detailed.
*   Whether demo videos or specific numbers of "installs" are prerequisites for partner certification (beyond the "ten active customer connections" mentioned as a checkpoint for review) was not explicitly stated.
